items.html: And behold, the first coupling is certainly very superior, for then it is the coupling of Aba and Ima while they are alone, without being clothed within others at all. Therefore the offspring produced from that coupling is the aspect of the Tzelem of Mochin that they bequeath to their children, who are ZON of Atzilut, so that the children themselves may couple to give birth to new souls of human beings, as is known.
